messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: ordinate axe in geom_density
parts:
Hi:

Here's a way to plot your toy example using count as the y-axis rather
than density:

DF <- data.frame(x = rnorm(500))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = x)) + geom_density(aes(y = ..count..), fill = "darkorange",
color = "darkorange", alpha = 0.5)

If you're plotting multiple densities in one graphics region, here's a
similar toy example:

DF2 <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(500), x2 = rnorm(500, 1, 0.5))
library(reshape2)
DF2m <- melt(DF2)

ggplot(DF2m, aes(x = value, fill = variable)) +
geom_density(aes(y = ..count..), alpha = 0.5, color = NA)

To see why I used color = NA, try

ggplot(DF2m, aes(x = value, fill = variable, color = variable)) +
geom_density(aes(y = ..count..), alpha = 0.5)


Dennis
